dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave curvature on the posterior margin from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with low-pixel-radius rounding at the peak.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree posterior slope relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.4:1 ratio of maximum base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex curve with a moderate radius forming a smooth transition from the blowhole region to the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick projection with length approximately 0.5 times the melon height.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 135 degrees at the melon-rostrum junction.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan surface coloration and visible low-poly geometric mesh topology.
